# rv

> Reversible shell actions — git-tree snapshots, append-only journal, per-path undo. https://github.com/DrVelvetFog/reversible

- [README](README.md)
- [SPEC](SPEC.md)

## Verified examples

- [manifest](examples/manifest.json): runnable examples for rv
- [attestations](examples/attest.json): in-toto Statements — which version each example last ran against, exit code, output digest
- Check before use: `xv check --rerun` (https://github.com/DrVelvetFog/verified-examples)
